shellCommands.command: git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -name package-lock.json -print | head -50

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json

cd node_modules/next; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_instant\|prefetch=\"auto\"\|unstable_dynamicOnHover" --include=*.md . 2>/dev/null | head -20; cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

git status --short && (npx next start -p 3456 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- full prefetch:" && curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3456/projects/acme | grep -o 'Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront[^"]*\|Loading [a-z.]*' | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- navigation:" && curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3456/projects/acme | grep -o 'Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront[^"]*\|Loading [a-z.]*' | sort | uniq -c
sleep 2; cat /tmp/next.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3456/projects/acme; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3456/projects/acme | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; for p in 3 2 none; do echo "--- prefetch header: $p"; if [ $p = none ]; then H=(); else H=(-H "Next-Router-Prefetch: $p"); fi; curl -s -L -H 'RSC: 1' "${H[@]}" "http://localhost:3456/projects/acme" -o /tmp/out.$p -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}B\n'; grep -o 'Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront\|Loading [a-z]*' /tmp/out.$p | sort | uniq -c; done
pkill -f "next start" ; cat .gitignore; git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short
